summary: Master aviation safety management systems with ICAO Annex 19, risk tools, and SMS reporting. Build practical skills in 5 days.
lede: Aviation safety management systems provide a structured way to identify hazards, assess risks, and monitor safety performance. Training on ICAO Annex 19 is intended for aviation professionals responsible for safety processes who need to design and improve an SMS with clear evidence of control. It covers hazard registers and risk assessment, safety performance indicators, and assurance reviews, with practical work on risk registers, dashboards, and action plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for aviation professionals who already work with safety processes and need to strengthen SMS design, assurance, and reporting.
prerequisites: Recommended prior knowledge includes basic aviation safety terminology, routine incident or hazard reporting, and familiarity with operational control environments. Learners should bring a laptop for workbook exercises and, where possible, sample safety records, KPI summaries, or an existing SMS gap list for practical application.
